quote: Don’t do unto others what you don’t want others to do unto you!.

“Your actions echo in the lives of others.
If you crave kindness, offer it.
If you fear cruelty, avoid it.
Peace begins not with grand gestures, but with the quiet choice to cause no harm.”
Thirty years the river flows east, thirty years the river flows west; don't bully the young and poor.
“Life turns like a river. Today you may mock the weak — tomorrow, they may rise above you. Respect everyone, especially those still growing.”
—Xiao Yan | Battle tThrough the Heavens
It doesn't matter if you don't have talent; the only thing you need is to overcome laziness.
“You don’t need talent to succeed — just the discipline to show up when it’s hard.“
